title: Penciclovir Cream
overview: Penciclovir is used on the lips and faces of adults to treat cold sores caused by herpes simplex virus. Penciclovir does not cure herpes infections but decreases pain and itching if applied when the earliest symptoms first appear.

sections.Before using penciclovir,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to penciclovir, acyclovir (Zovirax), or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while taking penciclovir, call your doctor.
sections.Penciclovir may cause side effects. Tell: headacheirritation at the site of application
